General Dynamics Mission Systems provides mission-critical solutions for defense, intelligence, and space applications. The Software Engineer will research, design, develop, and test innovative software applications and embedded systems supporting national security missions, while collaborating with project leaders and cross-functional teams on emerging technologies.
Computer Software
No H1B
Security Clearance Required
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
As a Software Engineer at General Dynamics Mission Systems, your responsibilities will include assisting project leaders with the research, design, and development of software solutions tailored to mission-critical applications
You will contribute to the development of new products and enhancements to existing systems, ensuring they meet rigorous standards for quality and security
Your tasks will encompass coding, testing, and documenting software applications, embedded systems, and tools
You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to integrate emerging technologies and support system deployment
Additionally, you will participate in code reviews, troubleshoot software issues, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
Your role may also involve hardware interfacing, especially with Raspberry Pi and other embedded platforms, as well as leveraging cloud services to optimize system performance and scalability

Required
The successful candidate will possess a Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related Science, Engineering, or Mathematics field
Equivalent experience will also be considered
Candidates must be eligible for a U.S. Government security investigation
U.S. citizenship is required due to the sensitive nature of work performed
Strong understanding of software engineering principles, development processes, and coding best practices is essential
Experience with cloud services such as AWS and Kubernetes, as well as hardware experience with Raspberry Pi, Linux, MATLAB, and Digital Signal Processing (DSP), will be advantageous
Candidates should demonstrate the ability to learn quickly, handle increasing responsibilities, and thrive in collaborative team environments
Preferred
Prior experience with Agile methodologies is preferred
ideally hold or be able to obtain a Department of Defense Top Secret clearance
